Entertainment Tonight on Instagram: "Kieran Culkin accepted Sean Penn's Best Supporting Actor #Oscar in the most Kieran Culkin way possible.

As for where Sean was, the New York Times reports he missed the awards ceremony in order to visit Ukraine.

The 98th Academy Awards air on ABC and Hulu."
